label:
Naive scalar baseline
(shipped)
note: KernelBuilder.build_kernel as shipped: one scalar op per bundle, no valu, no packing.

label:
Vectorized with valu
(pipeline_width=1)
note: 8-wide valu across the batch; idx/val resident in scratch for a group's whole round-lifetime instead of round-tripping through memory every round; algebraic parity simplification removes one select. No cross-group pipelining yet, so valu's 6 slots are mostly unfilled (see rust_harness stats: 17% fill).

label:
Pipelined, valu-packed
(pipeline_width=6)
note: Interleaves 6 independent groups' instruction streams per phase so valu's 6 slots/cycle actually get filled (a single group's hash-stage dependency chain only offers 2 independent ops at a time). rust_harness stats: valu fill jumps 17%->43%, load engine (the unavoidable per-lane tree-node gather, no vector gather in this ISA) becomes the clear bottleneck at ~99% packing whenever busy.

label:
gaddr+fused hash
pipelined port
note: Port of the analysis findings to the grader: gaddr carried instead of idx, cross-stage hash fusion (11 mixing ops), gather-under-compute pipelining, level-0 broadcast. Measured at e66b208.

label: list scheduler
note: Dependency-tracking list scheduler replaces wave emitter; wraparound compare/select compiled away. Measured at 4b6a6b8.

label: L1 tournament
note: Level-1 rounds served from scratch via broadcast madd-select; gathers removed. Measured at 492da6b.

label: L2 tournament
note: Level-2 tournament folds (cond masks + vselect). Measured at 91c8145.

label: alu offload
note: Elementwise vector ops split into 8 scalar alu lanes when they retire earlier; compute throughput toward 7.5 vec-ops/cyc. Measured at 02be4df.

label: single-temp hash
note: Slight regression that freed 235 scratch words, funding L4 + skew. Measured at b1a6e2b.

label: L4 group-split
note: Partial level-4 tournament (groups >= l4_gmin per epoch) to avoid stalling the load stream. Measured at 9a3cd9d.

label: pool retune
note: Temp pools retuned with the freed scratch (17 hash temps, 4 cond slots). Measured at 75023d5.

label:
group skewing
(4 blocks, lag 3)
note: Blocks of 8 groups emitted 3 rounds apart: compute-heavy epochs overlap other blocks' load-bound levels. All 9 grader thresholds pass. Measured at 13f4f0c.

label:
parity conds
(H-001)
note: Tournament conditions from raw parity vectors riding the dead nv buffer; cond-extraction masks eliminated (alu 94.6->87.0%). First research-loop accept.

label:
schedule-aware
fold placement (H-017)
note: First tournament folds race flow-vselect vs valu-madd at emission (243/448 flip); L4 service retuned to (20,29), pools (16,3). Hard flip rejected per G-4; valu floor now 1073 cyc-equiv.

label:
C5-pre-xor domain
(H-015 composed)
note: Tree/table values pre-xored with C5; 9 of 16 rounds drop the ^C5 op (parity closed via table reversal, zero extra ops). Composed retune with vsel_auto: va=(1,2), l4_gmin=(15,29), pools (17,4).

label: sweep: va=(1,3)
note: Phase-3 sweep under 1088: vsel_auto=(1,3) beats (1,2) by 1 under c5_prexor.
